files.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one individual transparent PNG 2D fighting-game walk animation frame, square 1024 by 1024. Edit the supplied character sprite. Preserve the reference character's exact face, hairstyle, clothing, gloves, submachine gun, painterly linework, palette, detail level, lighting and right-facing side-view orientation. Keep the gun held securely with both hands in the exact chest-high guard of the reference, no firing effect. Preserve upper-body size and identity. Redraw only the walking stance, natural trousers folds and tiny body response needed for an authentic grounded step. Full body with clean true transparent alpha, no ground or cast shadow. Maintain top of hair at y=55 and lower edge of grounded shoe at y=960 on this 1024 square canvas; central animation origin remains (512,960), body centered on x512. One character, one pose, nothing else. Do not make a sheet, multiple figures, labels, text, borders, floor, scene, added equipment or motion trail. Do not mirror or flip the source. Both arms and gun remain aimed to the RIGHT in both phases. The feet and legs must change visibly from the wide stationary guard into an anatomical walking contact pose.
Pose WALK1: the near-side leg is extended FORWARD to image-right, its shoe heel contacting the y960 ground line near x650, toe pointing right and slightly lifted. The far-side leg extends backward to image-left, its heel lifted and ball of the shoe contacting near x390. Mid-stride length substantially narrower than the stationary fighting stance; both legs visibly separate. Weight travels right, pelvis stays centered, no jump, no crouch. Render the same side of the character as the reference.
Costume invariants: brown side-parted hair, fully long striped white sleeves with buttoned cuffs, charcoal waistcoat without a chain, striped dark and gold tie, navy trousers, polished black shoes, same black compact gun. Keep the stylized painted face from Image 1.
files.registration_note: Native canvas retained. Origin x is canvas midpoint; y is measured grounded-shoe lower edge at alpha>=128. Use normalized values in renderer, not the requested-but-unfulfilled 1024 size.

files.correction_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached individual transparent game sprite into the OPPOSITE LEG STEP. Retain 1280x1280 transparent canvas. Absolutely preserve every part ABOVE THE WAIST including head position, face, hairstyle, shirt, waistcoat, arms, both hands and submachine gun: same pixels, same position, same scale and facing RIGHT. Change ONLY trousers and legs BELOW THE WAIST. In the current image, the near thigh runs diagonally down-right across the front. CHANGE THAT: draw the visible near-side thigh running diagonally DOWN-LEFT from the near hip, its knee visibly behind the hip, then its shin angled DOWN-RIGHT toward a heel-lifted rear shoe at image-left. The visible outside trouser seam must follow the leg BACK to image-left, not cross in front to image-right. Draw the far-side leg passing BEHIND that near thigh and extending FORWARD to image-right, fairly straight, with its shoe heel planted on the ground at y1180 near x815 and toe pointing right. This is an anatomical reversed support pose, back leg belongs to near hip and front leg to far hip. It must have clearly different knee locations and opposite overlap ordering versus input, not merely different wrinkles. The near/rear knee should be around (480,875); the far/front knee around (730,865). Keep full figure, black shoes, navy trousers, source painterly linework, genuine alpha outside figure. No mirroring, no additional figure, no text, no ground or shadow.
files.registration_note: Native canvas retained. Origin x is canvas midpoint; y is measured grounded-shoe lower edge at alpha>=128. Use normalized values in renderer, not the requested-but-unfulfilled 1024 size.
